description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing a theme ('dark' or 'light') in a React application. It includes the context creation, a provider component that manages theme state and side effects, and a hook for consuming the theme context.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: A React component that provides theme context to its children, managing theme state and applying theme attributes to the document.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: A custom hook to access the theme context value within React components.
